articles.summary: Horace Mann Educators Corporation (NYSE:HMN), the largest multiline financial services company focused on helping America’s educators and a core small- to mid-cap growth and value equity in the Financials sector, today reported financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026: Diversified business delivered third-quarter net income of $58.5 million, or $1.41 per share, and record core earnings* of $85.1 million, or $2.06 per share Net investment income increased 17% over prior year; premiums, contract charges and fee revenue increased 3% Third-quarter Property Casualty segment combined ratio of 83.6% improved nearly 4 points over prior year Increased full-year 2026 core EPS guidance to $5.75-$5.95 ($ in millions, except per share amounts) Three Months Ended September 30, Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026 2025 % Change 2026 2025 % Change Total revenues $ 439.2 $ 438.5 0.2 % $ 1,312.0 $ 1,266.6 3.6 % Net income 58.5 58.3 0.3 % 141.3 <
